neutral.anchor_measurement: Manual visual measurement in native source pixels; approximate anatomical registration, not a subpixel motion/alignment acceptance.
neutral.anchor_basis: Visual midpoint at the lowest supporting walking-leg tip regions. Body reference is shell height, excluding stalk eyes, both claw arms and walking legs.
neutral.vertical_motion_policy: Grounded neutral; use anatomical foot support for consumer scene placement. No baked jump or vertical displacement.

geometry_policy: Native pixels and adopted per-frame references retained. Atlas neutral coordinates are shifted only by the adopted crop origin.

taxonomy.verification_scope: Primary linked sources check the identity/selected diagnostic traits where listed; visual_traits are a concise original artistic brief, not a claim of exhaustive field-identification accuracy.
